name: prompt-input
title: Prompt input
description: A chat input with file attachments and a submit button that follows the AI SDK chat status.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Plus } from "@lucide/vue";
import { onScopeDispose, useAttrs, useTemplateRef } from "vue";
import { usePromptInput } from "./context.ts";
import type { PromptInputAttachProps, PromptInputAttachSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const { variant = "outline", disabled = false, label = "Add attachment" } = defineProps<PromptInputAttachProps>();
defineSlots<PromptInputAttachSlots>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const context = usePromptInput();
const input = useTemplateRef<HTMLInputElement>("input");
// The prompt takes files while an attach button that is not disabled is in it, so a paste adds files too.
if (context) onScopeDispose(context.addAttach(() => disabled));
const locked = () => disabled || (context?.disabled.value ?? true);

async function onChange(event: Event) {
  const target = event.currentTarget;
  if (!(target instanceof HTMLInputElement) || !context) return;
  await context.addFiles(target.files ?? []);
  target.value = "";
}
</script>

<template>
  <template v-if="context">
    <input
      ref="input"
      type="file"
      data-slot="visually-hidden"
      tabindex="-1"
      :accept="context.accept.value"
      :aria-label="label"
      :disabled="locked()"
      :multiple="!context.single.value"
      @change="onChange"
    >
    <button
      v-bind="attrs"
      type="button"
      data-slot="prompt-input-attach"
      :data-variant="variant"
      :aria-label="label"
      :disabled="locked()"
      @click="input?.click()"
    >
      <slot><Plus data-slot="prompt-input-attach-icon" aria-hidden="true" /></slot>
    </button>
  </template>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ArrowUp, LoaderCircle, RefreshCw, Square } from "@lucide/vue";
import { computed, useAttrs } from "vue";
import { usePromptInput } from "./context.ts";
import type { PromptInputSubmitSlots } from "./types.ts";

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
defineSlots<PromptInputSubmitSlots>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
const context = usePromptInput();

const labels = { error: "Retry prompt", ready: "Send prompt", streaming: "Stop response", submitted: "Stop response" } as const;
const status = computed(() => context?.status.value ?? "ready");
const label = computed(() => (status.value === "ready" && context?.submitLabel.value) || labels[status.value]);
// Stop and Retry stay pressable while files are read; only Send waits for them.
const loading = computed(() => status.value === "ready" && Boolean(context?.preparing.value || context?.readonly.value));
// Stop stays pressable, so a running reply can end.
const inactive = computed(() => (status.value === "ready" && !context?.canSubmit.value) || (status.value === "error" && Boolean(context?.disabled.value)));
// Solid once there is something to send, so an empty box does not end in a dark button.
const variant = computed(() => (status.value === "ready" && !context?.canSubmit.value ? "soft" : "solid"));
const scope = computed(() => ({ canSubmit: context?.canSubmit.value ?? false, preparing: context?.preparing.value ?? false, status: status.value }));
</script>

<template>
  <template v-if="context">
    <!-- The spacer puts the submit button at the end of the toolbar. -->
    <span data-slot="prompt-input-spacer" />
    <button
      v-bind="attrs"
      type="button"
      data-slot="prompt-input-submit"
      :data-status="status"
      :data-variant="variant"
      :data-loading="loading ? '' : undefined"
      :aria-label="label"
      :disabled="inactive || loading"
      @click="context.press()"
    >
      <LoaderCircle v-if="loading" data-slot="prompt-input-submit-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
      <slot v-else v-bind="scope">
        <ArrowUp v-if="status === 'ready'" data-slot="prompt-input-submit-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
        <RefreshCw v-else-if="status === 'error'" data-slot="prompt-input-submit-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
        <Square v-else data-slot="prompt-input-submit-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
      </slot>
    </button>
  </template>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, ref } from "vue";
import { usePromptInput } from "./context.ts";
import { touchOnly } from "./files.ts";

const context = usePromptInput();
// Read after mount, so the server and the client render the same first markup.
const touch = ref(false);
onMounted(() => {
  touch.value = touchOnly();
});

// Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line. Composing text with an input method never sends. On a touch-only device the
// on-screen keyboard has no Shift+Enter, so Enter adds a line and the send button sends.
function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!context || event.key !== "Enter" || event.shiftKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey || event.isComposing) return;
  if (touchOnly()) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  if (context.status.value === "ready" && !context.disabled.value && !context.readonly.value) context.requestSubmit();
}

// A pasted picture is attached. Other files are attached only when the clipboard has no text, so a paste from an
// office app that also carries a picture of the text pastes the text.
async function onPaste(event: ClipboardEvent) {
  const clipboard = event.clipboardData;
  if (!context?.takesFiles.value || !clipboard) return;
  const hasText = clipboard.getData("text/plain").length > 0;
  const files = Array.from(clipboard.files).filter((file) => file.type.startsWith("image/") || !hasText);
  if (files.length > 0) await context.addFiles(files, () => event.preventDefault());
}

function onInput(event: Event) {
  if (context && event.target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) context.text.value = event.target.value;
}
</script>

<template>
  <textarea
    v-if="context"
    data-slot="prompt-input-textarea"
    :aria-label="context.label.value"
    :enterkeyhint="touch ? 'enter' : 'send'"
    :placeholder="context.placeholder.value"
    :aria-busy="context.readonly.value ? 'true' : undefined"
    :disabled="context.disabled.value"
    :readonly="context.readonly.value"
    rows="1"
    :value="context.text.value"
    @input="onInput"
    @keydown="onKeydown"
    @paste="onPaste"
  />
</template>
